title: Attendance
work_remote_desc: Work from home or co-working space
work_selector_subtitle: Please select your work location for this shift. Attendance policies differ per work type.
no_time_logs_recorded_today_yet: No time logs recorded today yet.
geofence_unavailable: The office geofence could not be loaded, so your location can't be verified. Check your connection and try again, or switch to Field Duty on the home screen.
shift_completed_msg: Your shift ({{start}} - {{end}}) is complete. Please Clock Out immediately.
shift_almost_complete: Your shift is almost complete. Please remember to clock out.
gps_disabled_notif_body: Your GPS is turned OFF. Shift attendance tracking is halted. Please enable GPS immediately to record attendance.
auto_clock_out_msg: You have been outside the office geofence for more than 8 hours and have been automatically clocked out.
shift_active_body: Location tracking enabled for shift validation
mode_field_desc: Geofence restrictions disabled. You can now clock in and clock out from anywhere.
mode_office_desc: Standard office geofence rules are now active.
loc_perm_msg: Because location access is required to track shift attendance, you are unable to clock in. Please allow location access.
bg_perm_msg:
Because shift attendance must be validated continuously even when the app is minimized or your phone screen is locked, you are unable to clock in without 'Allow all the time' location permission.

Please select 'Allow all the time' in Settings.
gps_disabled_msg: Because device GPS / Location Services is turned off, you are unable to clock in. Please turn ON GPS on your device.
battery_msg:
Because Android pauses attendance tracking for battery-optimized apps, you are unable to clock in until battery optimization is turned off for HRMS.

Tap 'Turn Off', choose 'Allow', then clock in again.
no_coords_clock_in: Because location coordinates could not be determined, you are unable to clock in. Office employees must be within the office geofence.
outside_clock_in_msg:
Because you are outside the office geofence boundary, you are unable to clock in.

• Nearest boundary: {{distance}}m away
• Allowed radius: {{radius}}m

If you are on field duty, please switch to Field Duty shift on the home screen to clock in from anywhere.
clock_in_unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during clock-in.
must_clock_in_first: You must clock in first before you can clock out.
no_coords_clock_out: Because location coordinates could not be determined, you are unable to clock out. Office employees must be within the office geofence.
outside_clock_out_msg:
Because you are outside the office geofence area ({{distance}}m away, allowed: {{radius}}m), you are unable to clock out in Office Shift mode.

Switch to Field Duty shift on the home screen or return within the office boundary to clock out.
act_not_running: This activity is no longer running.
act_extra_question: How much extra time do you need, and why?
act_reason_placeholder: Why do you need more time?
act_late_reason_hint: This activity ran late, so finishing needs a reason.
act_saved_offline_msg: There is no connection. The activity will be sent as soon as you are online, with the time you started it.
act_running_msg: "{{title}}" is still running. Finish or cancel it first, then your new activity will start.
act_alarm_hint: When the time is up your phone will ring and ask how much extra time you need.
act_empty_day: No activities logged for this day.
act_dropped_old: An activity saved offline was not sent because it started more than 12 hours ago.
act_dropped_conflict: An activity saved offline was not sent because another activity was already running.
act_dropped_rejected: An activity saved offline was rejected by the server and was not sent.
act_waiting_sync: SAVED ON THIS PHONE · WAITING FOR A CONNECTION
act_err_title_long: The title can be at most 120 characters.
act_err_end_required: Choose when you will be done.
act_err_end_past: The end time must be later than now.
act_err_end_far: The end time can be at most 16 hours from now.
act_err_minutes: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 960.
act_err_extra_minutes: Enter a whole number of minutes from 5 to 480.
act_err_reason_short: The reason needs at least 3 characters.
act_err_reason_long: The reason can be at most 500 characters.
act_err_network: No connection. Your input is kept; try again.
act_err_generic: Something went wrong. Your input is kept; try again.
reg_withdraw_msg: Your request for {{date}} will be cancelled. You can send a new one later.
reg_send_again: Send a new request for this day
reg_empty: You have not sent any requests yet.
reg_camera_needed_msg: Allow camera access in your phone settings to photograph a document.
reg_pick_failed: Could not add the file. Try again.
reg_subtitle: Worked on a day you forgot to clock in? Ask to be marked present. Your admin will review it.
reg_comment_placeholder: What did you work on, and why could you not clock in?
reg_err_date_required: Choose the day you want to regularize.
reg_err_date_too_old: You can only regularize the last 31 days.
reg_err_comment_short: The comment needs at least 3 characters.
reg_err_comment_long: The comment can be at most 1000 characters.
reg_err_time_order: "Until" must be later than "I worked from".
reg_err_doc_type: Only photos and PDF files can be attached.
reg_err_doc_size: Each file can be at most 10 MB.
reg_err_doc_many: You can attach at most 5 files.
reg_err_network: No connection. Your comment and files are kept; try again.
reg_err_generic: Something went wrong. Your input is kept; try again.
act_worklist_failed: The list of work could not be loaded, so an activity cannot be started yet.
act_worklist_empty: There is nothing to choose from for your work place yet. Ask your admin.
